0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 2-0 and first in the Northwest, host the LA Clippers, who are 1-1, seventh in the West, and one game back in second place in the Pacific, in the third game of the 2026-27 season for the Thunder. The Thunder are 1-0 at home and have won both games so far, while the Clippers have lost their most recent game and are 1-0 at home and 0-1 on the road. Oklahoma City won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 128-110 victory in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026, and the Thunder are without Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery).
